attempt.answered: {{contact}}'s last attempt reached this app and did not connect:

attempt.label: Last attempt at {{time}}
attempt.none: No attempt of {{contact}}'s has reached this app yet.

clockOff.hint: This device's clock seems to be off by about {{amount}}. Chats may be slow to connect.
clockOff.infoAhead: The time on this device is about {{amount}} ahead of what the relays and your contacts' devices say. Ghostly dates what it sends by this clock, and other apps refuse or delay what is dated too far from their own time: chats and groups can be slow to connect, calls may not ring, and an app that has not been updated may not connect at all. Set the date and time to automatic in this device's settings. This note goes away once the clock agrees again. It takes several sources that agree, never one contact alone.
clockOff.infoBehind: The time on this device is about {{amount}} behind what the relays and your contacts' devices say. Ghostly dates what it sends by this clock, and other apps refuse or delay what is dated too far from their own time: chats and groups can be slow to connect, calls may not ring, and an app that has not been updated may not connect at all. Set the date and time to automatic in this device's settings. This note goes away once the clock agrees again. It takes several sources that agree, never one contact alone.
clockOff.title: Device clock

directBlocked.hint: Direct connections are blocked on this network (a VPN or firewall?). Chats still work through relays, but connect more slowly.
directBlocked.info: This device's recent direct connection attempts all failed: no public address was found, or several contacts could not be reached directly. A VPN, a firewall or a mobile carrier can cause this, and the app cannot tell which. Messages and files go through relays or the DHT instead. A relay sees which devices talk and when, never what they say. Calls need a direct path or a TURN server (Settings, Network). This note goes away when a direct connection works or the network changes.
directBlocked.title: Direct connections blocked

panel.discoveryHelp: Discovery will retry automatically. You can still share this invite or choose a delivery mode. If this persists, check your internet connection or {{link}}. DHT-only also needs discovery.

panel.keyMismatch: This key does not match the saved contact. No data was accepted; the saved key has not been replaced.
